quay_button: A boatman waves from the dark

offer.title: Qasim the boatman
offer.text: A flat boat with no lamp. Qasim lifts the cloth: clay jars sealed with pitch. “Wine from the far bank. The judge has forbidden it inside the walls, so it pays. Carry six jars to the back lanes tonight: twenty coins.”

done.title: Twenty coins
done.text: You carry the jars through the dark lanes to a door that opens before you knock. Qasim counts twenty coins into your hand. “Same time tomorrow.”

talk: Jars at the quay after dark
